company.name: Wren
company.shortDescription: Wren is a web app that helps live carbon neutral by accounting for and offsetting CO2 emissions.
company.description:
Wren is a web app that helps live carbon neutral by accounting for and offsetting CO2 emissions. It aims to build tools that help everyone act against climate change. Starting with a subscription service has the added advantage of funding their future work. They believe the most effective way we can build a team to tackle this problem is to build a sustainable business.

It was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.

productsAndServices.description: A tool to calculate individual or business CO2 emissions based on various activities and inputs.
productsAndServices.name: Carbon Footprint Calculator

productsAndServices.description: A subscription service allowing individuals to offset their calculated carbon emissions monthly by funding climate projects.

productsAndServices.description: A service for businesses to fund certified carbon removal projects and meet sustainability targets through tailored offset portfolios.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Carbon Offset Portfolios for Business

productsAndServices.description: An application programming interface that allows businesses to integrate Wren’s carbon offsetting and tracking capabilities into their own systems.
productsAndServices.name: Wren API

productsAndServices.description: A service enabling philanthropists to create climate giving strategies and donate to climate projects through tax-advantaged donor-advised funds or stock donations.
productsAndServices.name: Philanthropy Climate Giving via Donor-Advised Funds

productsAndServices.description: Guides offering tailored recommendations to individuals on how to reduce their carbon footprint based on their calculated emissions.
productsAndServices.name: Personalized Carbon Reduction Guides
